$comment: Scene slots and factory recipes, read by frontend/lib/contract.ts, App\Support\Project\Contract and engine-core/tests. sceneVector is both the list of parameters a scene holds and the order of indices 32..43 of the engine's scene vector (docs/NIGHT3_PROTOCOL.md). A recipe is relative to the track: scale multiplies the track's own level for that stem, cut mutes it, and a stem not listed keeps the track's level. Params not listed take their registry default.

factory.name: Full
factory.description: The track as written: every part at its own level, effects at their defaults.

factory.name: Sparse
factory.description: The breakdown. Hats, bass and pad carry it; the kick, clap and top parts step out.

factory.name: Build
factory.description: Reduce the bass, keep the hats, and darken the mix before the return.

factory.name: Drop
factory.description: The return. Kick and bass back at full, the filter open, the lead and stab back in, the pad tucked under.
